title: Confidential Router (router-api) configuration
description: YAML config of apps/router-api (conf/router.yaml, env overrides CR_API_*). `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders are expanded before validation. Endpoints and models are the source of truth for the Endpoint/Model tables (docs/contracts/data-model.md).

host.description: Interface to bind. 127.0.0.1 to keep the service off the network.

migrationsRun.description: Apply pending migrations at boot. Defaults to true on sqlite and false on postgres, where a deployment runs the migration job once instead of racing every replica.

logging.description: Log every SQL statement. Development only.

baseUrl.description: In-cluster LiteLLM base URL (plain http allowed; same cluster space).

hostname.description: Public router hostname; the platform serves /.well-known/swarm-evidence for it.

tee.description: Operator-declared TEE label shown in the console (e.g. 'Intel TDX + H100 CC').

evidenceUrl.description: Override for fetching this endpoint's own bundle from inside the cluster. Operator-only.

declaredImages.description: Allow-list of the container images this endpoint is supposed to run, pinned by digest — the same shape as a marketplace AppDefinition's component `images` (swarm-marketplace-spec §2.7). The console compares it against the digests in the endpoint's signed deployment evidence: an image the evidence carries and this list does not is surfaced as undeclared. Operator-declared, so it is a statement of intent and never a verdict; omit it and the console reports that nothing was declared rather than implying a match.

name.description: Image reference without tag or digest, e.g. ghcr.io/super-protocol/router-api.

litellmModel.description: Model name as configured in LiteLLM.

freshnessWindow.description: Snapshots older than this render as STALE.

externalEndpoints.description: The egress sidecar that attests external model endpoints (ADR-008). The endpoints themselves are not configured here: an admin registers them at runtime and router-api renders them into the sidecar's own config file. This section configures the seam between the two processes. The upstream API keys are deliberately absent — they are stored encrypted in the database under CR_API_SECRETS_KEY and injected by router-api on the egress leg, never written into the rendered file.

configFile.description: Where the rendered sidecar config is written — the shared emptyDir both containers mount. The sidecar's entrypoint watches this path and SIGHUPs its own process on change.

adminListen.description: The sidecar's admin API, which router-api polls for verdicts. unix:<path> or a loopback host:port only — it answers with verdicts, and local-only is the whole of its access control.

listenPortBase.description: First loopback port the per-endpoint listeners are allocated from. Loopback is shared within the pod, so there is no Service, no cluster traffic and no exposure.

listenPortRange.description: How many consecutive ports the allocator may use, and therefore the ceiling on external endpoints.

reattestInterval.description: Background full re-verification period for every external endpoint. Bounded to [1m, 1h]: "hourly" was named as the acceptable worst case, so a longer interval is refused at boot rather than accepted as a preference.

statusPollInterval.description: How often router-api reads the sidecar's /status and /verdicts back. 0 disables the poll.

mailer.description: `none` disables magic-link sign-in, for a deployment with no mail provider.

password.description: Email and password sign-in, for a deployment with no mail delivery at all. No email verification and no password reset: both need a mailer.

requireInviteForSignUp.description: Invite-only registration. While this is on, no sign-up path creates an account without an invitation code that is valid and unredeemed at that moment; sign-in of existing accounts and POST /auth/bootstrap are unaffected.

bootstrapToken.description: While this is set and no user exists, POST /auth/bootstrap trades it for the first account and a session. Blank counts as unset; otherwise at least 16 characters.

bootstrapEmail.description: The address the bootstrapped first account is created under.

adminEmails.description: Addresses allowed to read the operator-only parts of the console schema (invitation-campaign aggregates). Empty means nobody: the user table belongs to Better Auth, so there is no role column to put this on.

provider.description: Which payment provider binds. "auto" is Stripe when it is configured and the manual provider otherwise; the manual provider mints credit from a signed link, so it is refused in production and on any server.publicBaseUrl that is not a loopback address. "disabled" sells nothing: checkout is refused and the console hides the buy panel.

maxTopUpMicros.description: Ceiling on a single top-up, in micro-USD. Must not be below minTopUpMicros.

checkoutReturnUrl.description: Where the payment provider sends the browser back after a checkout.

autoTopUpCooldown.description: Floor between two automatic top-ups of the same workspace.

invites.description: Invitation codes that grant credit. Inert until codes are generated.

landingBaseUrl.description: Origin the generated invitation URLs point at: the campaign landing page, not this service.

lookupsPerMinute.description: Per-source-address budget on the public GET /v1/invites/{code}.

analytics.description: Product analytics (ADR-006). Inert without a PostHog project key; the console reaches PostHog only through this service, never directly.

posthog.description: PostHog capture. Usually set from POSTHOG_PROJECT_KEY and POSTHOG_HOST rather than written here.

projectKey.description: The phc_... project key. A write-only ingest key, not a secret. Unset means every event is discarded.

host.description: Ingest origin. The EU cloud by default.

requestTimeout.description: Capture request timeout. Short: a slow analytics host must cost a dropped event, never a slow response.

ingestPerMinute.description: Per-source-address budget on the console's POST /v1/analytics/events.

feedback.description: The second $100, earned by telling us how the first one went (SUP-149). Inert until `form` is set.

grantMicros.description: Micro-USD a completed form credits. $100 is 100000000.

offerBelowMicros.description: Offer the form once the balance falls below this, so it arrives before the account is blocked.

minMeteredTokens.description: Tokens the workspace must have spent first, so the grant cannot be farmed by an account that never used the first one.

tokenTtl.description: How long the signed token in the form's hidden fields stays valid. Minutes, not days.

webhooksPerMinute.description: Per-source-address budget on POST /v1/webhooks/typeform. The signature is the authority; this only bounds the work.

form.description: The hosted form. Omit it and the feature is off end to end.

url.description: Where the console sends the user. The signed token is appended as a hidden field.

webhookSecret.description: Shared with the provider by the typeform-setup workflow. Never committed.

chat.description: The console's Chat screen (SUP-180). Sanity limits only: the chat calls the same /v1/chat/completions as any other client, with a real workspace key, and is metered the same way.

enabled.description: Off removes the screen and refuses the credential mutation, for a deployment that wants the API and nothing else.

maxMessageChars.description: Longest single message the composer accepts. The limit on a whole thread is the model's own context window, which the screen reads from the catalogue.

maxThreads.description: How many threads one member may keep, so a demo surface cannot become a free storage service. Note the product maxThreads × maxMessagesPerThread × maxMessageChars is the storage one member can occupy — about 80 MB at the defaults.

maxMessagesPerThread.description: How many messages one thread may hold.

credentialTtl.description: How long the key the chat mints for itself stays valid. Hours, not days: it only has to survive one sitting at the screen.

pretty.description: Human-readable output. Defaults to true outside production.

gatekeeper.description: Where the console's Gatekeeper screen reads its download links. GoReleaser publishes the binaries to this repository's GitHub Releases (ADR-001).

cacheTtl.description: How long a fetched release is served before the next call is made.

token.description: Optional GitHub token. The anonymous API is rate-limited per source IP, which one NAT-ed console can exhaust.
